title: P15.10-D R1: artifact CAS re-verification + grant dedup + receipt-auth binding
description: R1 on PR #88 (BASE 88470ee). F1 CONFIRMED+FIXED: verifiedUnits trusted artifact.state==ACCEPTED rows only — deleted/tampered retained CAS bytes still minted progress. Fix: the service takes ArtifactAuthority (canonical blobDir = PAIR_ARTIFACT_DIR ?? dbDir/artifacts/blobs, same resolver as telegram-delivery) and re-verifies every candidate via verifyArtifactForConsumption (acceptance history + canonical shape + retained bytes NOW) inside the same txn; corruption fails closed. F2 CONFIRMED+FIXED: grant() stored dedup_key but never consulted it — replay after revoke minted a fresh ENABLED grant. Fix: dedup scan inside the txn before the enabled-check — same (objective,key)+same semantics (business,kpi,rule_digest,expires_at,owner,created_by) returns the stored row (REVOKE durable), different semantics fails closed, dups converge. F3 CONFIRMED+FIXED in shared assertKpiVerifierAuthority: added receipt.authorization_id===verifier auth, receipt.evidence_key===claim key, receipt.rule_digest===grant.rule_digest — revoked-grant receipts and tampered grant rules no longer satisfy new verifiers; write path and P15.5 strict read share the contract. F4 VERIFIED (no change): revoke/expire after progress makes strict read fail closed FAIL_CLOSED_P15_5_ADAPTIVE_REVIEW; persisted value untouched; owner re-verification recovers. F5 VERIFIED (documented): DELIVERABLE_BUNDLE proves canonical deliverable completion only; receipt.verified_units binds workstream/work_item/mission/artifact ids — no content semantics, no AI judge. R1 suite: 10 tests, prepatch FAIL→postpatch PASS; 22 original + 340 regressions green. No merge/deploy.
